dropdowns.q: How do I sign up for a workshop, retreat, or event?
dropdowns.a: You can sign up online. No need to sign up for our men’s circles! Just show up.

dropdowns.q: Where is the the centre located?
dropdowns.a: The Centre is located in Petulu- a ten minute drive north of Ubud on the beautiful island of Bali, Indonesia.

The Centre has about 10 are (1000 m2) of covered building space, including a comfortable meeting space and a yoga shala. It also has 5 are (500 m2) of outdoor garden space including sunny seating areas and an extensive pond. Our communal spaces easily accommodate 30 people, with additional space for activities like Qigong, breathwork, yoga, and meditation.

dropdowns.q: What materials will you have for me to use at the Centre?
dropdowns.a: All yoga equipment including blocks, mats, blankets, and bolsters will be provided. Please reach out if there are other materials you require for your event.

dropdowns.q: How will LGL support me in hosting a retreat?
dropdowns.a: Expect all needed resources and our hands-on support in organising, planning and selling your retreat, so you’re never alone. Specifically, we will help you with: Booking a space to accommodate your guests’ sleeping arrangements. Booking a caterer. Promoting your event. Accepting booking payments. Trust us to treat your clients' with love and care, so that they can come home to themselves.

dropdowns.q: How will LGL help me promote my event?
dropdowns.a: We will advertise your event on our website and social media platforms at no extra cost.

dropdowns.q: Can LGL help create a simple booking process for my guests if I don’t have a website?
dropdowns.a: Yes! We can create a web page and booking system through our site for a 15% fee of each booking made through our system.

dropdowns.q: Does LGL have space to accommodate retreat guests?
dropdowns.a: Our centre has one luxury villa. There are no accommodation spaces on site for retreat guests. Instead, EC invites retreat hosts to stay on-site for the duration of their retreat and guests to support the Balinese by staying in nearby locally-owned accommodation options. We have compiled a list of recommended guesthouses and hotels to support any budget. Please contact us for our detailed recommendation list of nearby accommodations. Retreat hosts are welcome to organize their preferred accommodation option, or, for a small fee, EC staff can organize the guest accommodations for the hosts.

dropdowns.q: Does the centre provide meals for its retreat guests?
dropdowns.a: LGL has a small kitchen to help prepare food brought in, we instead aim to support local Indonesian caterers in and around Ubud. Please contact us for our detailed recommendation list of nearby caterers. Retreat hosts are welcome to organize their preferred catering option, or, for a small fee, EC staff can organize catering for the hosts.

accordions.a: Harnessing the sun’s heat to supply our showers and baths with beautifully steamy hot water to relax and cleanse our bodies.

The rain runoff (from our gutters and underground piping) utilizes the force of gravity which creates movement within our natural pool to ensure a healthy water ecosystem for the aquatic life making this their home.
Wastewater is naturally filtered through a worm septic tank and earth filtration system to recycle the water for reuse on the plant life and pond health

Beginners and Novices: If you are new to Reiki, this program provides a welcoming entry point, guiding you through the fundamentals and empowering you to harness the healing energy. Healing Enthusiasts: For those passionate about holistic well-being and self-healing, this training offers tools and techniques to enhance your personal healing journey. Healthcare Professionals: If you are a healthcare practitioner looking to complement your existing skills with holistic approaches, Reiki can be a valuable addition to your toolkit. Yoga Instructors: Yoga instructors seeking to expand their offerings and provide additional healing modalities to their students can benefit from incorporating Reiki into their practice. Anyone Seeking Personal Growth: Whether you're on a quest for personal growth, stress reduction, or a deeper spiritual connection, Reiki Level I & II provides a transformative path toward achieving these goals. Those Exploring Energy Healing: If you are curious about energy healing and its potential, this program offers a comprehensive introduction, demystifying the principles of Reiki. Aspiring Reiki Masters: Individuals drawn to the power of healing energy who wish to deepen their understanding and embark on the journey toward Reiki Mastery. No matter where you are on your journey, if you're drawn to the transformative power of healing energy and eager to explore the depths of your own potential, our Reiki Level I & II Training, including the Reiki Master Level, welcomes you with open arms.
